what: Put a "Find a member" box (name or mobile) in the top bar on every page, on a computer and in the phone's header, that opens the member's page
why: At rush hour the desk is on Today or Attendance and has to switch to Members to look someone up; the top bar holds only Refresh, the bell and the screen switches
impact_why: Looking up a member is the desk's most common job, many times an hour
my_view: My view: do it. Gym desk software like Mindbody, Glofox and Gymdesk keep a search box on every screen (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live). Reuse the member list already loaded on the device, so it works offline too.

what: On a phone, let Send on WhatsApp on the member card share the card picture straight into WhatsApp through the phone's share sheet
why: Today the desk must tap Download picture, then Send on WhatsApp, then find and attach the picture in the chat: three steps and a file hunt
impact_why: Every member card sent from a phone; most desks run the app on a phone
my_view: My view: do it. The 'Your gym is ready' card already uses the phone's share sheet; phone browsers can share a picture with words the same way. Keep the old two-step way for computers.

what: After Approve on a member's renew request, show "Take payment now" on the same line, opening Collect payment for that member and plan
why: Approve adds the fee to what the member owes, then the line is done; the desk must find the member again to take the money
impact_why: Every renew request from the app; unpaid renewals become dues to chase
my_view: My view: do it. One button after the green 'approved' line; the money step stays separate so nothing is charged by mistake.

what: Let Decline on a member's pause or renew request carry a short reason chip (Please talk to the desk, Pause days used up, Plan not open to renew) that the member sees in the app
why: Decline sends no reason, so the member only learns 'no' and comes to the desk or messages to ask why
impact_why: Saves a conversation per declined request and keeps the member's trust
my_view: My view: worth it, but small: three fixed chips plus 'no reason', never free text, so no rude words reach a member. Needs a server field and the member app to show it.

what: Add an owner-to-owner loop: "Recommend MettleUp to another gym" with a ready WhatsApp message and the owner's own link, shown on Your growth and after the owner's first good month
why: The panel has a Bring a friend loop for members but nothing that asks a happy owner to bring another gym; Your growth only prints and downloads
impact_why: Gym owners know other owners; one referred gym is a full yearly fee
my_view: My view: do it once the paid plans are on. The reward (for example a free month for both) is your money decision, so I would build the message and link first and add the reward after your yes.

what: On each Your numbers list (owe fees, plans ending, stopped coming), add "Message all on WhatsApp" using the existing one-by-one send list ("1 of 12, Open WhatsApp, Skip")
why: Each list has WhatsApp only per person, so messaging 12 members who owe means 12 separate opens of the sheet; the one-by-one send list already exists for Messages and the assistant
impact_why: These lists are where money and lapsed members are; the owner opens them to act on them
my_view: My view: do it. The send list, its memory of who is done and the message words already exist; this is a button on a list that already knows the right message kind per row.

what: Give bell to-do cards a "Remind me tomorrow" choice next to the X
why: Today X is the only way to quiet a card, and it moves the card to History, so something the owner meant to do later gets lost
impact_why: Owners handle the bell on the phone between other jobs; later is the usual answer
my_view: My view: worth doing after the alert fixes already in the list. One fixed choice (tomorrow morning) is enough; no snooze menu.

what: Add "Bring in your members from Excel" as a button on the 'Your gym is ready' card, beside Open the QR poster
why: A new gym starts empty, and the card's only next steps are the QR poster and Done; most owners move from a register or old software and need their members in first
impact_why: The first hour decides whether a new owner keeps using the panel
my_view: My view: do it. The Excel import and its hint already live in Set up your gym; this just puts the door where the owner is standing at that moment.

what: At the bottom of What's new and the bell's update summary, add "Tell us what to build next" that opens Send feedback with the topic picked
why: Owners read what's new but there is no ask for their wishes at that moment; Send feedback sits under More
impact_why: Feature wishes from paying owners steer the roadmap; asking where they already read updates raises replies
my_view: My view: do it; one link, no new screen. Read the replies weekly so the ask is not empty.

what: Let the desk scan a member's workout code as a QR with the desk camera instead of typing the 10-letter code
why: The desk types a code like K3Q9P-X2M7A from the member's phone; a typo gives a wrong 'no' at the counter
impact_why: Only gyms that run the workout offer use it, and only a few times a day
my_view: My view: later. Fix the repeat-reward and wrong-reward faults already found in this check first; then a QR in the member app plus the desk camera sheet that already exists.

what: Add a third choice, "Same as phone", to Dark | Light, following the device's own setting
why: The switch offers only Dark or Light, kept per device, so a phone set to switch at night stays on one look
my_view: My view: low priority. If done, keep it as an icon-only third option so the top bar does not grow.
